name: FakeObject
summary: Provides a working but much lighter implementation of what the system under test depends on, so that a real interaction can happen without the real cost.

roles.name: FakeObject
roles.summary: A double that actually works — an in-memory store standing in for a database. It is the only kind with behaviour of its own, which is why it is the only one that can have bugs, and why a fake that has drifted from the thing it replaces makes every test that uses it lie.
